taxonomy_strategy.principle: Keep the craft separate from subject, style and editorial purpose so the site can add new maker disciplines without restructuring existing content.

dimensions.craft: The making discipline: cross-stitch now; crochet, embroidery or woodworking later.
dimensions.section: Editorial job of the page: learn, ideas or buying-guides.
dimensions.topic: What the article is about: patterns, materials, animals, florals, finishing, decor, etc.
dimensions.style: Optional aesthetic layer: modern, pop-art, minimalist, retro, geometric, botanical, etc.
dimensions.project_type: Optional physical outcome: wall-art, home-decor, blanket, garment, furniture, storage, etc.
dimensions.article_type: Guide, how-to, comparison, inspiration, buying-guide and similar editorial formats.
